tagline: Someone is always heading your way. Trust them with your parcel.
subtitle: Verified Travelers have spare room in their luggage: your parcel arrives faster, cheaper, and hand-delivered.

find.title: Find a trip
find.description: Search your destination: Travelers heading there show their date, available kilos and price.

book.title: Book
book.description: You pay when you book, but the money stays held by Stripe until delivery.

handoff.title: Hand over your parcel
handoff.description: You arrange the meetup in Yamba's messaging, before the Traveler departs.

delivered.title: It's delivered
delivered.description: Your recipient gives the confidential code at handover — only you know it. The money is then released.

publish.title: Publish your trip
publish.description: Destination, date, available kilos, your price per kilo: it takes two minutes.

accept.title: Accept requests
accept.description: You see the declared contents and choose what you carry — nothing is forced on you.

deliver.title: Carry and deliver
deliver.description: You hand over the parcel against the delivery code: that's your proof of delivery.

paid.title: Get your earnings
paid.description: After delivery, your earnings are paid out to your account — the payment was secured from the booking.
